default/31388.htm.text: Mina: Welcome! We don't get many visitors in this village! Not many villagers any more, either, come to think of it! They all moved away. The few of us who remain survive by collecting fruit and hunting. It's a small village, but we get by!

links.text: "Why don't you move to Rune Castle Town?"

default/31388-1.htm.text: Mina: You don't mind asking personal questions, do you? Well, the easy answer is, because of my lord. She frowns on those who move around too much! When I refer to my lord, I mean the beautiful lord of the forest , not that despicable pig in the village!

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-01.ht.text: Mina: Surely you've seen the undead lurking about the village? They've been around as long as anyone around here can remember! Recently, we've been plagued by dark magi, and as you can imagine, it's been very chaotic! Things are so topsy-turvy, I doubt that the trees will even bear fruit this seaso…

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-02.ht.text: Mina: Thank you, but I seriously doubt that you could defeat the dark magi! We've been used to dealing with monsters, but these dark bastards are something else! They would kill you! Why don't you come back when you're older. (Only a character of level 65 or above can undertake this quest.)

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-04.ht.text: Mina: Oh, you're back! And you have brought proof of killing 200 Black Mages, yes? Very good, very good indeed! As I promised, you'll be well rewarded for your troubles. But, ah... well, as you can plainly see, our little village simply doesn't have the resources to cover your expenses on our own -…

links.text: Settle up for Black Magi Rib Bones.
Settle up accounts for Undead Livers.
Stop hunting (all proofs will be removed from inventory without reward)

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-05.ht.text: Mina: Hmm, how may I help you? Have you brought proof of killing 200 Black Mages? No? Any nasty undead livers? You'll be paid for those, but not much!

links.text: Settle up accounts for Undead Livers.
Stop hunting (all proofs will be removed from inventory without reward)

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-03.ht.text: Mina: Thanks for helping us! Basically, we need two things done. First and most important, wipe out the dark magi ! They are our biggest threat! Defeat them and you'll be well-rewarded! Please slay at least 200 of them! Also, I would ask that you please exterminate the undead that are wandering aro…

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-06.ht.text: Mina: Please, hunt black magi and bring back 200 proofs of their deaths! And don't forget the undead livers, our lord is paying for those, as well! Now, take your leave! Good luck!

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-07.ht.text: Mina: Here is your reward! I know it's not much, but it's all we can afford! Let me know if you want to hunt more Black Mages! And don't forget, we love those undead livers! Our lord's rewards are ample, don't you think?

links.text: Settle up accounts for Undead Livers.
Stop hunting (all proofs will be removed from inventory without reward)

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-08.ht.text: Mina: Oh, did you kill 200 black magi? Hmm, that's strange! There aren't enough proofs here!? Do you think you might have dropped some of them on your way here?

Q00633_InTheForgottenVillage/31388-09.ht.text: Mina: You want to quit? Well, I won't stop you! Thank you for what you've done! Have a great trip! All you'll see is corpses, though... Ha!
